episodes.title: Star Struck
episodes.short_desc: With a bounty on Emmett's head, the crew refuels at Dack-12, blacks out the station, and flees with a celebrity racer whose ship just exploded.

episodes.title: Junk Food
episodes.short_desc: Stranded at a junk pit while a slime mechanic fixes the ship, the crew gets duped by a shapeshifter and wrecks a roadside diner.

episodes.title: Tickled Pink
episodes.short_desc: Iris and Garrick follow two armored ducks into ruins beneath the junk pit, where a pink ghost swallows Iris and leaves her able to shapeshift.

episodes.title: Hear Me Out
episodes.short_desc: Emmett gets swallowed by the mechanic, Seth rams an 8-ball-headed stranger's ship, and a mysterious voice starts speaking in Emmett's head.

episodes.title: Behind the 8-Ball
episodes.short_desc: While Emmett fights grass withdrawal, the crew locks up its delusional 8-ball-headed passenger and takes a contract on Richard Jamerez.

episodes.title: Dinner Is Served
episodes.short_desc: The crew assassinates Richard Jamerez in the Llamanian Underground while a craving-fueled Emmett wrecks his own room.

episodes.title: Give Peas a Chance
episodes.short_desc: Emmett wakes up leashed and pelted with peas by Seth, who dies, visits Elf Heaven, and comes back as an alien tumor baby.

episodes.title: Suit Yourself
episodes.short_desc: Arriving at the vacation planet Zarazoga-9, the crew gets ready for a beach day while Seth impersonates Sanya.

Volentina Constantini.anchor_contains: I told you I'd be back
